commands.name: \SemioVizSciSample
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciSample{seq}{expr}{from}{to}{n}: uniform sampling of an l3fp expression over \SemioX.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciRefine
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciRefine{seq}{expr}{passes}{tolerance}: adaptive midpoint refinement of a sampled sequence.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciRiemann
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciRiemann{expr}{from}{to}{bins}{rule}: Riemann sum; the value is pushed with \SemioVizSciPushResult.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciRK
commands.signature: m m m m m m m
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciRK{x'}{y'}{x0}{y0}{h}{steps}{seq}: Runge–Kutta trajectory into a point sequence.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciDFT
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciDFT{samples}{magnitude seq}{phase seq}: discrete Fourier transform of a clist of samples.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciRoots
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciRoots{coefficients}{seq}: complex polynomial roots as (re,im) pairs.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciPush
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciPush{expr}: appends one l3fp value to the pending probe record.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciPushResult
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciPushResult: appends the last Riemann sum.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciPushPdf
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciPushPdf/Cdf{law}{p1}{p2}{x}: appends a distribution value.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciPushCdf
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciPushCdf{law}{p1}{p2}{x}: appends the cumulative value of the same distribution.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciPushQuantile
commands.signature: m m m m m m
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciPushQuantile{law}{p1}{p2}{p}{lo}{hi}: appends an inverse-cdf value.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciTF
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciTF{numerator}{denominator}{omega}: evaluates the transfer function on the imaginary axis.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciPushTF
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciPushTF: appends the magnitude and the phase in degrees of the last \SemioVizSciTF.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciPushCount
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciPushCount{seq}: appends the number of points a sequence holds.

commands.name: \SemioVizSciPushPoints
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciPushPoints{seq}: appends a point sequence flattened to x,y,x,y…

commands.name: \SemioVizSciEmit
commands.note: 🧪 \SemioVizSciEmit{key}: writes the pending numbers as one probe record and clears them.
